qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the transmission socket to case connection on 4HP-22 EH/4HP-24EH/A5S 310Z transmissions?
What screw size is used for both transmission types shown in the wire harness shift elements and sensor section?
qa_pairs.answer: M26 screw size is used for both transmission types.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque value for A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmission socket to case?
Which transmission types are covered in section 24 35 for wire harness, shift elements and sensor specifications?
What unit of measurement is used for the torque specifications on this page?
What is the difference in torque specifications between the two transmission types listed?
qa_pairs.answer: The 4HP-22 EH/4HP-24EH/A5S 310Z requires 12 Nm while the A4S 270R/A4S 310R requires 14 Nm, a difference of 2 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the automatic transmission wire harness, shift elements and sensor specifications?
What component is being torqued according to the 1AZ specification?
Which transmission type requires the higher torque value for the socket to case connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmission requires the higher torque value of 14 Nm.
